03 / PUMP MODULE MASTERY

Investigate the Alaris 8100 Pump Module

Bench intake: an 8100 pump module arrives with door closure, delivery or alarm complaints. Training only; no patient connected.

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

Identify pump module assemblies and distinguish mechanical, sensing, interface and electronic faults using observed evidence.

Your assignment

  1. Follow the guided inspection stations in order.
  2. Review the component view and bench relevance.
  3. Distinguish the pump door latch from the module release.
  4. Complete thirteen scenario-based questions.
  5. Retake missed questions until 100% mastery.

Learning outcomes

  • Recognize door latch and platen faults.
  • Distinguish pumping and sensor symptoms.
  • Identify interface and electronic faults.
  • Recognize required post-service verification.
